title: After ten years, Apple is totally changing how it makes iPhone software - and users should be ecstatic (AAPL)
text: After ten years, Apple is totally changing how it makes iPhone software — and users should be ecstatic (AAPL) By Kif Leswing Feb 12, 2018, 7:09 pm 36 pts Apple is reportedly focusing the next version of iOS, the iPhone software, on performance and policy. This is great news for iPhone owners, who have increasingly been noticing bugs and glitches in Apple's software. Apple is expected to release the new version of iOS in September. If you use an…
